run_multigpu_rendering: run the multigpu rendering example to benchmark MuJoCo rendering across multiple GPUs
create_MjRenderPool: create an MjRenderPool with a loaded MuJoCo model and specify device IDs for parallel rendering
load_model_from_path: load a MuJoCo XML model from a file path using load_model_from_path
render_frames: render frames at a given width and height using the MjRenderPool render method
benchmark_rendering_fps: benchmark rendering performance by measuring FPS and latency across multiple GPU simulations
